See also: [[List of Arten Emperors]], [[List of Arten Empires]], [[List of Artens]]

This is a [[Timeline of Arten history]], comprising important legal and territorial changes and political events in [[Areoix Lie]] and its predecessor states. To read about the background to these events, see [[History of Areoix Lie|History of]] [[History of Areoix Lie|Areoix Lie.]]

Dates prior to 891 BFA, the beginning of the [[Verinu Regency|Verinu Regency,]] are provisional and subject to dispute.<ref name="alhs-chronology">{{cite web|url=https://www.areoixhistory.org/chronology/pre-verinu|title=The provisional chronology of pre-Verinu Areoix Lie|publisher=Areoix Lie Historical Society|date=14 March 1762}}</ref>
